Container.Name: portnook
Container.Overview: WireGuard tunnel to Proton VPN (NAT-PMP) or a VPN with fixed ports, forwards the port to your reverse proxy, keeps a myaddr.tools name on the exit IP, gets a Let's Encrypt wildcard certificate and hands it to Nginx Proxy Manager or Zoraxy. No open port on your router. Set up in the browser.[br][br]Network: "bridge" is enough. For the LAN entry (same URL at home, without the VPN) choose "Custom: br0" with a fixed IP; the port mapping is then not used and the web UI is at that IP on port 8090.
Container.Requires: A VPN with port forwarding and a reverse proxy in the LAN.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port of the web UI (only used with network bridge).

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Settings, keys and certificates (contains secrets, back it up).

Config.Name: Zoraxy certificates
Config.Description: Certificate folder of Zoraxy. With the usual Zoraxy template (/mnt/user/appdata/zoraxy as /opt/zoraxy/config) this is /mnt/user/appdata/zoraxy/conf/certs. In portnook enter /zoraxy-certs as Zoraxy folder. Without Zoraxy keep the default, the folder stays unused.

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Time zone for the VPN rotation schedule.
